cards.title: The park bench
cards.alt: Two backpacks on matching benches beside identical bottles: a large blue backpack and a small red backpack.

questions.question: Was the blue backpack bigger than the red backpack?
questions.answer: Yes, it was. The blue backpack was bigger than the red backpack.

questions.question: Was the red backpack bigger than the blue backpack?
questions.answer: No, it wasn’t. The red backpack was smaller than the blue backpack.

cards.title: Two parks
cards.alt: Three young short trees in Park A and three tall mature trees in Park B, with matching benches.

questions.question: Were the trees in Park A taller than the trees in Park B?
questions.answer: No, they weren’t. The trees in Park A were shorter than the trees in Park B.

questions.question: Were the trees in Park B taller than the trees in Park A?
questions.answer: Yes, they were. The trees in Park B were taller than the trees in Park A.

cards.title: The city buildings
cards.alt: A tall blue building and a short yellow building, shown at the same scale.

questions.question: Was the yellow building taller than the blue building?
questions.answer: No, it wasn’t. The yellow building was shorter than the blue building.

questions.question: Was the blue building shorter than the yellow building?
questions.answer: No, it wasn’t. The blue building was taller than the yellow building.

cards.title: The clothes display
cards.alt: Two long red scarves and two short green scarves on matching display rails.

questions.question: Were the red scarves longer than the green scarves?
questions.answer: Yes, they were. The red scarves were longer than the green scarves.

questions.question: Were the green scarves shorter than the red scarves?
questions.answer: Yes, they were. The green scarves were shorter than the red scarves.

cards.title: Two town visits
cards.alt: A cold mountain town with people in coats and a warm sunny town with people in light clothing.

questions.question: Was Town B colder than Town A?
questions.answer: No, it wasn’t. Town B was warmer than Town A.

questions.question: Was Town A colder than Town B?
questions.answer: Yes, it was. Town A was colder than Town B.

cards.title: Two picnic days
cards.alt: Friends at a sunny lakeside picnic on Saturday and at a cool cloudy picnic on Sunday.

questions.question: Was Saturday warmer than Sunday?
questions.answer: Yes, it was. Saturday was warmer than Sunday.

questions.question: Was Sunday warmer than Saturday?
questions.answer: No, it wasn’t. Sunday was colder than Saturday.

cards.title: Saturday’s jacket prices
cards.alt: Red and blue jackets displayed in a clothing store; the red jacket cost 80,000 pesos and the blue jacket 120,000 pesos.

questions.question: Was the red jacket more expensive than the blue jacket?
questions.answer: No, it wasn’t. The red jacket was cheaper than the blue jacket.

questions.question: Was the blue jacket cheaper than the red jacket?
questions.answer: No, it wasn’t. The blue jacket was more expensive than the red jacket.

cards.title: Saturday’s shoe prices
cards.alt: White sneakers and black sneakers, priced per pair at 90 US dollars and 40 US dollars.

questions.question: Were the black shoes cheaper than the white shoes?
questions.answer: Yes, they were. The black shoes were cheaper than the white shoes.

questions.question: Were the white shoes more expensive than the black shoes?
questions.answer: Yes, they were. The white shoes were more expensive than the black shoes.

cards.title: An afternoon at the park
cards.alt: Park A has a reader by a lake; Park B has a crowd and a concert. Sound readings show 32 and 78 decibels.

questions.question: Was Park A quieter than Park B?
questions.answer: Yes, it was. Park A was quieter than Park B.

questions.question: Was Park A more crowded than Park B?
questions.answer: No, it wasn’t. Park B was more crowded than Park A.

cards.title: The Saturday shoppers
cards.alt: Shop A has many customers between clothing racks; Shop B has one customer and empty aisles.

questions.question: Was Shop B more crowded than Shop A?
questions.answer: No, it wasn’t. Shop A was more crowded than Shop B.

questions.question: Was Shop A busier than Shop B?
questions.answer: Yes, it was. Shop A was busier than Shop B.

cards.title: Last weekend at the beach
cards.alt: Beach A has scattered bottles and wrappers; Beach B has clean sand, with the same hut and umbrella.

questions.question: Was Beach A cleaner than Beach B?
questions.answer: No, it wasn’t. Beach B was cleaner than Beach A.

questions.question: Was Beach B cleaner than Beach A?
questions.answer: Yes, it was. Beach B was cleaner than Beach A.

cards.title: Saturday on two streets
cards.alt: Street A has many pedestrians, cars and litter; Street B has one pedestrian, no cars and a clean pavement.

questions.question: Was Street A busier than Street B?
questions.answer: Yes, it was. Street A was busier than Street B.

questions.question: Was Street A cleaner than Street B?
questions.answer: No, it wasn’t. Street B was cleaner than Street A.
